name: emet
description: EMET 0.3.2 is an MCP memory server built for document control (ISO 9001 7.5.3 / ISO 13485 4.2.5): persistent, shared memory for AI agents and bot teams. It holds no certification and claims no conformity. Nothing is deleted; records are superseded, retired and retained. Per-client attribution and approvals on every write. Client-side GEM execution: EMET verifies the record, not the computation. A GEM is seated only when its released flag is true. Connects to your own self-hosted EMET server over remote HTTP with OAuth.

EMET_URL.title: Your EMET server URL
EMET_URL.description: Full MCP endpoint of your own EMET server. Paste the whole URL, for example https://their-host/mcp, not the bare host. See docs/DEPLOY.md.
